body:
I had a thought and figured I would post my truncated project as well, even though it does not have the error.

Main idea was since I was using an app_settings script that extended a resource, maybe when I was copying and pasting the values to my cigam_settings script which extends a node, that it somehow made a connection between them like the error in this issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/102422 Where 2 files shared existence somehow. It also would have been a copy and paste like the crash issue.

Not sure if they are all related, but wanted to share that as a potential route to find the issue.

[mrp_node_error_on_run.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18677913/mrp_node_error_on_run.zip)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/af5fd99b-2037-4b47-86ec-f7bf15e92e1e

Okay, this is not a bug, it was just me being dumb. The settings file I was saving out was originally from using the App_Setting resource, which has the script saved in the settings file. When it was loading into my Cigam_Settings as a node, it was breaking, because it was trying to read the app_settings script onto the Cigam_Settings node. Since I had not resaved out the settings file with the new script and node.

Here is an updated version of my prior MRP with it now repeating that error:

[mrp_node_error_on_run.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18681046/mrp_node_error_on_run.zip)


This can be closed, archived, or however it needs to be. Unless there is something more that can be added to the error to show where the error came from, like in this case from loading the file.

Cheers!
